content:
Factorisation is multiplication played backwards — and like all backwards games, it punishes half-measures. The IMO’s favourite trick is a factorisation that LOOKS finished but hides one more step inside. Take the free IMO Class 8 Factorisation online test below before any revision. Ten MCQs, instant score, full explanations — it will tell you exactly what to fix first.

What the IMO asks from Factorisation in Class 8

  • Taking out the HCF; factoring by grouping.
  • Identities in reverse: a² − b² and perfect-square trinomials.
  • Splitting the middle term of x² + px + q.
  • Dividing a polynomial by a monomial or a binomial.
  • Multi-layer factorisations like x⁴ − 16.

Key facts and formulas to revise first

  • Always pull out the HCF first: 12x² + 18x = 6x(2x + 3) in one step.
  • x² + 5x + 6 wants two numbers with SUM 5 and PRODUCT 6 — that is 2 and 3.
  • x⁴ − 16 = (x² + 4)(x + 2)(x − 2) — the difference of squares fires TWICE.
  • Check any division instantly: dividend = divisor × quotient.

Mistakes that cost Olympiad marks

  • Stopping at (x² + 4)(x² − 4) — the second bracket still factors.
  • Cancelling single terms across a + sign in algebraic fractions.
  • Dividing only the first term of the numerator by the denominator.

quiz.title: IMO Class 8 Factorisation Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten Olympiad-pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: If 4x²y - kxy² + 8xy = 4xy(x - 3y + 2), find the value of k.
questions.explanation: Expand the right side: 4xy(x - 3y + 2) = 4x²y - 12xy² + 8xy. Comparing with 4x²y - kxy² + 8xy, we get k = 12.
Group the terms: (x² + xy) + (-2x - 2y) = x(x + y) - 2(x + y) = (x + y)(x - 2).
Group: x²(x + 3) - 1(x + 3) = (x + 3)(x² - 1). Now x² - 1 = (x + 1)(x - 1). So the answer is (x + 3)(x + 1)(x - 1).
Using a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b) with a = 7x and b = 8y: 49x² - 64y² = (7x)² - (8y)² = (7x + 8y)(7x - 8y).
Check if it matches a² + 2ab + b²: x² + 2(x)(7) + 7² = (x + 7)².

questions.q: If a + b = 7 and ab = 12, find the value of a² + b².
questions.explanation: Using the identity (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²: 49 = a² + b² + 24. Therefore a² + b² = 49 - 24 = 25.

questions.q: If (x - 2) is a factor of x³ - 3x² + kx - 6, find the value of k.
questions.explanation: Since (x - 2) is a factor, substituting x = 2 must give 0: 8 - 12 + 2k - 6 = 0, so 2k - 10 = 0, k = 5. Verification: x³ - 3x² + 5x - 6 at x = 2 gives 8 - 12 + 10 - 6 = 0.
Product = 6 × (-10) = -60. Find two numbers with product -60 and sum 11: 15 and -4. Split: 6x² + 15x - 4x - 10 = 3x(2x + 5) - 2(2x + 5) = (2x + 5)(3x - 2).
Product = 10 × 15 = 150. Find two numbers with product 150 and sum 31: 25 and 6. Split: 10x² + 25x + 6x + 15 = 5x(2x + 5) + 3(2x + 5) = (2x + 5)(5x + 3).
